bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources, appropriating money to replace the Sullivan Lake Dam.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+SULLIVAN LAKE DAM; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources to replace the Sullivan Lake Dam in Morrison County. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources, appropriating money to replace the Sullivan Lake Dam.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. SULLIVAN LAKE DAM; APPROPRIATION.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources to replace the Sullivan Lake Dam in Morrison County.
additions: $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of natural resources to replace the Sullivan Lake Dam in Morrison County.
